'''Anatoly Moiseevich Vershik''' ({{langx|ru|Анато́лий Моисе́евич Ве́ршик}}; 28 December 1933 – 14 February 2024) was a [[USSR|Soviet]] and Russian mathematician. He is most famous for his joint work with [[Sergei Vasilyevich Kerov|Sergei V. Kerov]] on [[representation theory|representations]] of [[infinity|infinite]] [[symmetric group]]s and applications to the [[longest increasing subsequence]]s.

== Biography ==
Vershik studied at Leningrad State University (later renamed to [[Saint Petersburg State University]]), receiving his doctoral degree in 1974; his advisor was [[Vladimir Rokhlin (Soviet mathematician)|Vladimir Rokhlin]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=19387}}</ref>

Vershik worked at the [[St. Petersburg Department of Steklov Mathematical Institute of the Russian Academy of Sciences|St. Petersburg Department of Steklov Institute of Mathematics]] and at Saint Petersburg State University.  In 1998–2008, he was the president of the [[St. Petersburg Mathematical Society]].

In 2012, Vershik became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 29 August 2013.</ref> 
In 2015, he was elected a member of [[Academia Europaea]].
<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Vershik_Anatoly |title=Academy of Europe: Anatoly Vershik |website=Academia Europaea |access-date=10 October 2023}}</ref>

His doctoral students include [[Alexander Barvinok]], [[Dmitri Burago]], [[Anna Erschler]], [[Sergey Fomin]], Vadim Kaimanovich<!--Q102204628-->, [[Sergei Vasilyevich Kerov|Sergei Kerov]], Alexander N. Livshits<!--Q102204622-->, Andrei Lodkin<!--Q102170333-->, Nikolai Mnev<!--Q20054230-->, and Natalia Tsilevich<!--Q102203344-->.

He had a daughter, Estonian linguist [[Anna Verschik]]. 

Anatoly Vershik died on 14 February 2024, at the age of 90.<ref>[https://mccme.ru/ru/news-main/2024/02/15/140224-%D0%BD%D0%B5-%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%BE-%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B2%D0%B5%D1%80%D1%88%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B0/ 14.02.24 – не стало А.М.Вершика] {{in lang|ru}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title= In memoriam: Anatoly Vershik |date=17 February 2024 |access-date=February 21, 2024|url=https://caseazatmiftakhov.org/2024/02/17/in-memoriam-anatoly-vershik-december-28-1933-february-14-2024/}}</ref>
